crossEpisodeNotes: Episodes 21 and 24 are both bound to the same canonical Iranica locator, PDF p. 8, lines 296–299; the read passage mentions loss of control of Egypt and Hijaz by the end of 39/660. This records the source text and does not resolve either selection.
The Poonawala article is the sole source read for selections 1–25; the Madelung article is the sole source read for selections 26–28. All are modern scholarly syntheses.
The cited al-Tabari, al-Baladhuri, al-Waqidi, Masudi and other historical works were not read in this task. No primary Arabic passage, inscription, or complete book was consulted.
No campaign dossier or map was created, no selected identity/date was changed, and no historical approval is implied.
